explication: This repository contains Bitwarden’s non-mobile client applications: browser extension, web app, desktop app, and CLI. The browser tree shows a user-facing authentication and autofill product, including page DOM discovery, browser-background coordination, and popup settings; the README identifies the related Bitwarden server as the backend. Other substantial capabilities visible in the tree include billing, vault search, importing, and organization risk insights. The graph preserves these product areas, but many implementation relationships are unverified because their source was not sampled; those links are dashed.
